headline: Colorado Mesa end Regis's unbeaten run
dek: Regis had gone through the conference table without a defeat when Colorado Mesa, who had already held them to a draw, beat them on their own field. It is one of three defeats in Regis's season and the only one at a member's hands; Rollins and Dallas Baptist took the others before conference play opened.
